title: banding-berths-at-the-general-level
intention: Lift nest, banding and the gradation from their tenant-local berths (assembly in import_sieve, shake in build_inspector) to a block-general primitive at cairn/tools/base/nest.py, with build_inspector as the named first tenant, so any inspector or block can carry a nest and a consumer can read the gradation without importing a tenant.
why: The ruling closes the open edge build_inspector's charter names in for_whom: the gradation/component_scores/per-finding score added 2026-08-06 stood 'emitted, unconsumed' pending exactly this ruling. The lived symptom the general berth serves: Akien asks 'does the build pass a basic inspection?' and wants the answer EVER-LEARNING — 'we can keep making it smarter' (2026-08-07) — which needs the gradation at an address a learner can read, not locked inside one inspector. The berth precedent is probe.py; the promotion precedent is import_sieve's own entry ('generalized and moved once so it stops being one component's private habit').
traces_to: Ruling 2026-08-07-the-nest-is-block-general; Law 1 (assembly and shake compiled once at one address); I-learns-its-gates (the gradation as the substrate the sieve-learning nexus reads).

falsifier.proves_green: code-seam@v2's registered set: entry gate at the BUILDME forward crossing (cast ticket + this ticket's intent_berth and sorted_berth + berthed chart chain); build gate at the PROVEME forward crossing (build_inspector's nest over cairn/tools/base — which after the lift rides the very shake this ticket lands: the voyage's own build gate is the first live fire of the lifted code); emission gate at the WATCHME forward crossing (probe berthed at cairn/tools/base/probes/does_the_gradation_find_a_reader.py, importable, PROBE declared, carry and enough present, before the crossing); exit gate at the PROVED entry (proved_answers_the_chart — this ticket is chart-claimed, so the verdict artifact answering every criterion is owed); proof gate: plain-python teeth beside the code (cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_nest.py new, with the standing base/import_sieve/build_inspector suites green through the move).
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: the ruling 2026-08-07-the-nest-is-block-general verify still reads UNTOUCHED when this ticket claims done; the toy second tenant in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_nest.py cannot assemble and shake a nest importing ONLY cairn.tools.base.nest (the lift was a relabel); build_inspector's report shape changes (its standing gradation proofs go red); any of the three charter conforms is missing (base's what, import_sieve's what + stale filed_edge, build_inspector's for_whom citing the packet); reach derivation leaves import_sieve; or the boat stands short of PROVED when this ticket claims done.
falsifier.horizon: Re-read at: the first real second carrier (the watch's clear — likely the sieve-learning nexus); a tenant needing band meanings the in-hand..off-box vocabulary cannot carry (the band-semantics-are-general assumption's expiry); and when the hand-set floor of 12 inspections becomes tunable (learns-its-gates IOU, named at the cast).
